card.name: The word skin before rash or necrosis
card.fires_on: The word "skin" when it starts a skin-problem phrase such as skin rash, skin striae or skin necrosis. It also fires on small words or commas in lists of skin findings.

modes.label: skin before a finding
modes.description: The word skin sits right before rash, striae or necrosis in a list of symptoms or warnings.
modes.example: Patients with mononucleosis who receive amoxicillin and clavulanate potassium extended-release tablets develop<< skin>> rash.

modes.label: link inside skin-finding lists
modes.description: A linking word or comma follows skin-related terms and leads into another skin finding.
modes.example: thinning of the skin<< with>> easy bruisability, muscle wasting with

card.writes: It adds little clear output; the promoted tokens are mixed and the suppressed ones look unrelated.
card.plain: It lights up on the word "skin" when a skin rash or other skin change is about to be named.
